headline: N-able ships N-central zero-day hotfixes; OpenSSH SSHole due 11-12; Barracuda ESG due 11-13; Maersk probes data theft

bullets.text: New: N-able has released security hotfixes for the zero-day vulnerabilities that a researcher published, after keeping hosted N-central offline (4 outlets).

New: over 35,000 apps built with Grok are exposed online, some leaking confidential data and passwords. Also today: Maersk is investigating an IT security incident with data theft, and eMudhra revoked 8 more CAs after its key compromise.
Due tomorrow, 11-12: OpenSSH SSHole CVE-2026-123158 (exploited to breach Linux systems, 4 outlets), GPUStack CVE-2026-102895, FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779 and IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218.
Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 (auth bypass) and CVE-2026-111560 (OS command injection) are exploited in attacks (4 outlets); KEV due 11-13. Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935 is also due 11-13.
Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 (XXE) and Openwave Webtop CVE-2026-111793 are exploited despite patches; Outlook CVE-2026-124194 and Chrome CVE-2026-125350 are also in KEV, all due 11-24.

Still active: Vanderbilt on lockdown after ransomware (6 outlets), Ridgecrest Regional Hospital offline, two US school districts shut systems; SAP patched four CVSS 10.0 flaws (ICM2SHELL). The week ran 1.13x the 90-day average.

actions: N-able N-central customers: apply N-able's zero-day hotfixes now and review RMM activity for misuse.
Patch OpenSSH (CVE-2026-123158), GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex today; their KEV deadline is 11-12.
Barracuda ESG: apply fixes for CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (due 11-13) and hunt for compromise; patch Ivanti Connect Secure too.
Inventory any Grok-built or other AI-generated apps exposed to the internet; lock down access and rotate any secrets they hold.
Patch Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave Webtop, roll out Microsoft's November updates (Outlook CVE-2026-124194 first), and update Chrome.
Replace certificates chaining to eMudhra's revoked CAs and apply SAP's patches for the four CVSS 10.0 flaws.
